content.title: Twitter Outage Reported by Thousands: Is X Down and What Caused it?
content.text: Every time a social media platform is down or any disaster takes over social media, people are quick to rush over to X, but what does one do if X is down? Thousands of X (formerly Twitter) users are experiencing outages, as reported from 1:45 PM PT on March 23, 2026, worldwide through Downdetector with more than 4,000 users complaining, including app crashes (60%), website issues (25%), and login problems (15%). Users are experiencing "Something went wrong," ice cream errors, and frozen timelines on desktop/mobile from the US, UK, Canada, and India. Elon Musk has acknowledged the access issues, and the cause is yet to be determined, probably due to server overload or a Cloudflare glitch. Mobile is working partially, and the service is being restored.Twitter Outage Reported by Thousands: Is X Down?Downdetector spikes indicate significant disruption as users are unable to load feeds/posts or send DMs.Browser/Desktop seems to be hit the hardest as pages are not loading; on the app, spinning wheels are visible.As per Downdetector, a website that tracks website outages, complaints started rising as users in various regions faced difficulties in loading feeds, posting updates, and logging in.Complaints crossed 4K in just 30 minutes; there has been no word from X's engineering team apart from Musk's tweet.Check: Elon Musk to Launch X Money SoonWhat Caused Twitter Outage on March 23?As per the live outage tracking system, the number of reported issues increased significantly as people started reporting the issue on the website, mobile app, and even on the login service.The Downdetector charts usually display a spike when a huge number of people report a similar issue at a specific point in time, which might indicate a possible system-wide issue rather than a series of random glitches. In similar outages reported earlier this week like PlayStation Network being down, disruptions in the service were attributed to updates on the server side or even a surge in traffic. Such real-time tracking systems enable users to quickly determine if a service is facing a system-wide issue or not.Twitter Outage Fixes and Status UpdatesUsers may try forcing quitting and reopening the app, clearing cache via Settings > Data Usage > Clear Cache, opening an incognito browser, switching between Wi-Fi and data networks, or even a VPN connection. Users may also try checking downdetector.com or isitdownrightnow.com. There may be a need to wait 30 minutes to account for propagation delays. XSupport takes a long time to respond during a crisis. Bluesky and Threads are seeing increased traffic as alternatives. A 40% drop in reports indicates a strong recovery trend.Also read: Amazon vs Elon Musk: Amazon Wants to Block Musk's 1 Million Satellite PlanThe alleged outage on X serves as a reminder of how fast a problem with prominent social media sites can spread to millions of users. As engineers work to resolve the problem, users can likely expect to see continued updates regarding the alleged outage. Although problems like this are generally short-lived, they do serve to emphasize the significance of digital infrastructure in our daily lives.First Published: Mar 24, 2026, 06:14 IST
